posts.subject: Csgo player "tqgaming"
posts.bodyHtml:
This player TQ/Gaming named "(OXYGEN)-(TFOX)" Is been abusive to people 3 times now and got away with everything but this time I have a screenshot of him calling people faggots and directing stuff at me also on the demo you can tell him mic abusing and throwing inapropriate messages at player, You can tell people were muting the entire voice chat. "Before he called someone a prick, but I did not manage to record on time"

SS:
Demo:

Hey @OxygeN1337Gaming


I've watched the whole demo, that you've posted in here and I've seen not even one insult, that was meant in a serious way. Tqgaming is at most 12 years old, so start treating him appropriate and not like an even-aged person. Furthermore in my opinion you've been trying to get a rise out of him as you were reporting him for every sentence and every action that he made. In addition, you called an admin and I was sitting in the spectatormode for at least 15 minutes. There wasnt even one action, that was near to a reason for a ban. The calladmin-plugin was installed to guarantee, that an admin can be contacted, if there's for example a bhop-scripter on the server. The thing, that was really annoying for me, was, that you've contacted me for 4 times. At least after the second time it should be clear, that i wont take any further action against this player as he was breaking the rules in a bannable way. I would really appreciate for the future if you could be more careful with the usage of the calladmin-plugin. Conclusive there wont be any further action against tqgaming.


Best regards
Hypno
Not the first time people complaint about him
